title: Stride Rite Recalls Girl's Sandals Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The metal flower on the shoe can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 7,500.

title: Texsport Recalls Cedar Lake Heater/Cookers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The regulator on the heater/cooker malfunctions when a user switches from a cooking to heating option, or vice versa, the gas propane turns to liquid, which can flare easily and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 325.

title: Salsa Cycles Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle fork can bend above the disc brake mount, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,700.

title: Adobe Recalls High-Powered Magnets Distributed with Promotional Materials Package (Recall Alert)
summary: When two or more magnets are swallowed, they can link together inside a child's intestines and clamp onto body tissues, causing intestinal obstructions, perforations, sepsis and death. Internal injury from magnets can pose serious lifelong health effects. Units: About 500.

title: Country Life Recalls Target-Mins Iron Supplement Bottles Due to Lack of Child-Resistant Packaging
summary: The packaging is not child-resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The supplement tablets inside the bottle contain iron, which can cause serious injury or death to young children if multiple tablets are ingested at once. Units: About 1,100.

title: Gerber Recalls Machetes with Stitched Sheaths Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The Parang machete can cut through the stitching of the sheaths when the blade is taken from or replaced in the sheath, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 80,000 in the U.S. and 11,000 in Canada.

title: IKEA Recalls LYDA Jumbo Coffee/Tea Cups Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The cups can break when hot liquid is poured into them, posing a burn hazard. Units: 11,000 in the United States (220,000 worldwide).

title: Philips Recalls Metal Halide Lamps Due to Fire, Laceration Hazards
summary: The internal wiring can arc causing the lamp to catch fire or the glass to shatter. This poses fire and laceration hazards. Units: About 8,100.

title: DiveAlert Emergency Signaling Devices Recalled by Ideations Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The signaling device can malfunction when used and restrict the diver's air flow, posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 2,500.

title: Fred & Friends Recalls Baby Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The rattle's end cap can separate, releasing small parts, posing a choking hazard to small children. Units: About 47,500 in the United States and 9,300 in Canada.

title: Stile Products Recalls Tern Folding Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bike's frame can crack at the hinge on the top tube, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 175.

title: Swan Creek Recalls Loose Votive Candles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The candles can burn with a high flame, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 715,000.

title: Bel Air Lighting Recalls Chandeliers Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: The mounting loop that holds the chandeliers to the ceiling can break, causing the chandelier to fall, posing an impact injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 20,500.

title: Genlyte Recalls Capri Track Lighting Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: The light fixtures can fall off of the track rail, posing an impact injury hazard to bystanders. Units: About 80,300.

title: Horizon Hobby Recalls Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The positive and negative battery leads are incorrectly wired to the battery connector. The use or charging of the battery can cause the battery to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 117.

title: Kichler Lighting Recalls Chandeliers Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Lowe's Stores
summary: The chandelier's fixture loop that connects the hanging chain to the lamp can fail during use causing the chandelier to fall from the ceiling and injure bystanders. Units: About 48,900.

title: Paddywax Recalls Fragrance Diffusers Due to Violation of the FHSA Labeling Requirements
summary: The label on the diffusers violates the Federal Hazardous Substances Act (FHSA) by omitting the presence of petroleum distillates. Petroleum distillates pose an aspiration hazard if swallowed. Units: About 2,100.

title: Axis Arrows Recalled by Easton Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The arrows can break when fired and hit unintended targets, including the user and bystanders. Units: 20,700 in the United States and 1,800 in Canada.

title: Best Buy Recalls ATG Replacement Batteries for the MacBook Pro Due to Fire, Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The battery can catch fire while charging. Units: About 5,100.

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The firewall behind the driver and passenger seats can overheat and melt, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,500.

title: Strollers Recalled by Kolcraft Due to Projectile Hazard
summary: The inner tube of the tire on the stroller can rupture causing the wheel rim to fracture and fly off as a projectile, posing a risk of bodily injury and property damage. Units: About 96,000 in U.S. and about 510 in Canada.

title: BeBeLove Recalls Baby Bath Seats Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The bath seats fail to meet federal safety standards, including the requirements for stability. Specifically, the bath seats can tip over, posing a risk of drowning to babies. Units: About 5,600.

title: Buy Buy Baby Recalls Idea Baby Bath Seats Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The bath seats fail to meet federal safety standards, including the requirements for stability. Specifically, the bath seats can tip over, posing a risk of drowning to babies. Units: About 34,000.

title: Chelsea & Scott Recalls Idea Baby Bath Seats Due to Drowning Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Onestepahead.com
summary: The bath seats fail to meet federal safety standards, including the requirements for stability. Specifically, the bath seats can tip over, posing a risk of drowning to babies. Units: About 1,950.

title: Hammacher Schlemmer Recalls Teak Shower Stools Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The wood seat of the shower stool can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: 92 units.

title: Sam’s Club Recalls Outdoor Seating Groups Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The swivel bases on the chairs in the seating groups can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,200.
